DIV8.HEAD: § 230.144A Private resales of securities to institutions.

NOTE.P: 1. This section relates solely to the application of section 5 of the Act.
2. Attempted compliance with this section does not act as an exclusive election.

DIV8.P: (a) Definitions. (1) For purposes of this section, qualified institutional buyer shall mean:
(i) Any of the following entities, acting for its own account:
(A) Any insurance company as defined in section 2(a)(13) of the Act;

NOTE.P: A purchase by an insurance company for its separate accounts shall be deemed a purchase for the account of such insurance company.

DIV8.P: (B) Any investment company registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940.

NOTE.P: An entity may be formed for the purpose of acquiring the securities offered.

DIV8.P: (ii) Any dealer registered pursuant to section 15 of the Exchange Act;

EXTRACT.FP: Instruction to paragraph (a)(1): Reservoir properties must be considered.
EXTRACT.P: (1) Inside the extract, markers nest locally.

DIV8.P: (2) Accredited investor. Accredited investor shall mean any person.
(b) Accountant, as used in this section, means a CPA.

FTNT.P: 1 Paragraph (c) reflects proposals made in Release No. 6334.

NOTE.P: This note belongs to paragraph (d)(1), not to the deeper item.

DIV8.FP: Exemption. An unnumbered paragraph keeps its italic lead.

NOTE.P: A note to the whole rule goes to root level.
